run_d360_hand_launch: run the ROS2 launch file to start DIGIT360 hand nodes for connected devices
generate_d360_group_actions: generate a GroupAction with serial IO, image publisher, and audio nodes for a DIGIT360 device
load_hand_config: load a YAML config file and return right and left hand finger serial mappings
enumerate_d360_from_yaml: enumerate connected DIGIT360 devices from a YAML config and launch matching hand node groups
generate_launch_description: generate a ROS2 LaunchDescription with image_pub_type and hand_config launch arguments
